title: Shedeur Sanders, Deshaun Watson to alternate starts in Browns' first 2 preseason games

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Shedeur Sanders, Deshaun Watson to alternate starts in Browns' first 2 preseason games
sources.description: With the preseason upon them, the Cleveland Browns appear no closer to settling their quarterback competition than they were at the start of training camp. And they won't be for at least another two weeks.
